description: This file contains unit tests for the AcknowledgementForwarderActor class within a Java Akka-based project. It tests actor name determination, actor creation, and message forwarding behavior related to acknowledgements in the system.

classes.name: AcknowledgementForwarderActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behaviors of AcknowledgementForwarderActor using Mockito for mocking and Akka TestKit for actor testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the actor system and acknowledgement configuration before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: tryToDetermineActorNameFromNullHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that passing null headers to determineActorName throws a NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: determineActorNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the actor name determination returns the correct name based on headers containing a correlation ID.

methods.name: tryToDetermineActorNameWithMissingCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown if headers do not contain a correlation ID when determining the actor name.

methods.name: createAcknowledgementForwarderAndThreadAcknowledgementThrough
methods.description: Tests actor creation and message forwarding of acknowledgement signals using Akka TestKit.
